title: eragrostis spinosa
intro: Eragrostis spinosa, commonly known as Devil's Needle, is a type of grass native to Australia and parts of Asia. The plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and relieving pain. Its therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's ability to protect against oxidative stress and promote wound healing.
